The file field.bin contains 62 bytes: 01 followed by 61 zero bytes. This is ordinary mutable material. A physical tick is attempted after each completed reply, after its executable cells, including replies without cells. No tick occurs while paused. Deleting material does not restore it. Empty material is valid. A directory or symlink at field.bin is left untouched. A regular file is opened without following symlinks, using ordinary read/write permissions. Actual access or execution errors are returned without repairs. Hardlink aliases share any in-place changes. The condition-specific tick law follows below.

Actual stdout, stderr, exit status and resource boundaries return separately for actor cells and the physical tick. Unknown outcomes pause with evidence retained. Each reply has up to256 generated tokens within8192 total positions. Observation packets have an8192-byte serialized bound; overflow pauses after known effects are retained. Full raw records remain external; only explicit file operations store writing in /world.
